text: {"name":"ke_irq_guarded_dispatch","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Runs a reentrant IRQ-masked dispatch, updating a shared status record for a matching value and forwarding nonmatching values to `cmd_handler_c`.","subsystem":"ke","var_renames":{"v1":"irq_nesting_count","v2":"shared_value_slot","v3":"argument_matches_shared_value","v5":"remaining_irq_nesting","v6":"irq_restore_pending","v7":"status_record","v8":"copied_field_value","result":"handler_result"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":8,"meaning":"Status or state word in the shared record; assigned different values depending on whether the referenced object is present."},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Field read from the object referenced by the shared value and copied into the status record."},{"offset":48,"meaning":"Destination field in the shared status record for the value read at offset 12."}]}
